name: dumbbell lying straight arm press on floor
description: A single-arm straight-arm dumbbell press on the floor that trains shoulder blade control and the upper chest.
instructions: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and one dumbbell held straight above your chest; rest the other arm on the floor.
Keep your working elbow straight and shoulder stable.
Let the shoulder blade settle toward the floor, then reach the dumbbell upward by moving the shoulder blade without bending the elbow.
Lower with control, complete the set and switch arms.
